svg.aria-label: Timeline: gift invested, wait 5 years, four yearly tuition bills, leftover counted at end of last year
svg.text: Bill, bill, bill, bill (one each January)
One window: the gift, the wait, the four bills
Each January: pay any bill due first, then the balance earns that year's return. Leftover = balance at the end of the last year.
Illustrative structure only; no results shown. Window length is 9 years (Appendix C).
